Floating Gardens
Supply and Installation of HDPE Floating Wetlands for holding Aquatic plants with appropriate fixtures including specially designed bucket for maximum root development to enable nutrient removal in polluted water body including transportation to site and labour cost for assembly of fames, plants complete.
Material specification
High Density Poly Ethylene Floats of 330mm x 330mm and 60mm in overall depth and wall thickness of 3mm. 
Opening at the centre with 160mm dia at the top and 140mm at the bottom along with projections on the sides and provision for locking systems
6mm dia opening at the corners
Buckets of 170mm dia at the top and 140mm at the bottom along with projections on the sides and provision for locking systems
Plus shaped connector pin for interconnecting
3-inch HDPE pipes and elbows for supporting the floating frames
GI Wires 22 gaugue and PVC binders for fixing/binding
10mm Nylon ropes for anchoring
Minimum of 18 plants per square meter area of the wetlands.
Plants of different species for taking up nutrients from waterbody like Cannandica, Vetiver, Spider Lilly, Reed, Water Grass, Phragmites and other locally grown varieties in and around the waterbody.
 DLP on materials used for 2 years

itemList.description: Benches Supply, Transportation, Installation of Mild Steel (MS) Park Benches with Nano-CoatedWooden Finish (Teak/Rosewood Grains).The MS benches are manufactured from mild steel. The benches are treated with metal epoxy primer, jet black coating, and nano-coated with clear wooden finish Teak/Rosewood grains. The final finish is between 70 to 90 microns, made to endure corrosion, rust, oxidation, and is also protective against UV damage. The bench is made to withhold a seating capacity of 225 kgs. The benches are composed of 2mm thick 20x40mm pipes for the seat and 20x40mm for the backrest, with 7 pipes for the seat and 6 pipes for the backrest. The hand rest is made of a 20x40mm pipe, positioned 01 24" from ground level. The base plate is 80x80x6mm, with 4 plates per bench. The armrest will be curved on both ends, measuring 2ft in length each, joining the legs of the bench. Each leg of the bench will have a 4" diameter plate at the base. The grouting will be 6" into the surface. The dimensions of the bench are oft in length, 2ft in depth, and 3.6ft in total height, including the backrest. The seat height from the ground is 18", and the backrest height is 18". The manufacturer must possess a valid ZED (Zero Defect Zero Effect)
